## Chapter

Refs #<issue>. Plan: `docs/plans/<vol>.<n>-<slug>.md`

`Refs`, not `Closes`: `dev` is the default branch, so `Closes` would shut the issue on merge. L closes it after the Afterword.

## Handoff

- [ ] Every step in section 3 landed, or its deviation is named in section 5
- [ ] Every Rummage line has a test, seen red then green
- [ ] Every Defer has a trigger
- [ ] Scribe ran: README, docs, release note match the diff
- [ ] CI green

## Browse

Browse line from section 0, with what L saw.

## Review

- Nookkeeper: Signed off / Signed off with notes / Not yet
- L: merge

## Afterword

Filed on the issue before close. Its edits (House Rules, skills, briefs) are the branch's last commit.
